messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] CRITICAL - GPU pool us-west-2 exhausted, autoscaler unable to grow. ID INC-2026-0421. Observed queue growth and increasing 503s.

incident-bot: Detected signals: GPU queue length > 12k, average queue latency 28s, autoscaler at maxReplicas. Prometheus adapter heartbeats missing.

eva (oncall): seeing it, jumping in — checking HPA and metrics adapter now.

eva (oncall): `kubectl get hpa -n inference inference-gpu -o yaml` -> currentReplicas: 20, desiredReplicas: 20, maxReplicas: 20. HPA at ceiling.

ben (sre): are we blocked because prom-adapter isn't feeding custom metrics? last time that caused delayed autoscale.

carla (ml-infra): prometheus-adapter logs show repeated timeouts to Prometheus and a heartbeat gap. grabbing logs.

carla (ml-infra): ```
# prometheus-adapter (tail)
E0421 14:34:10.123 prom_adapter.go:256] error querying Prometheus: context deadline exceeded
W0421 14:34:15.456 adapter.go:112] last successful heartbeat 240s ago
```

ops-bot: Alert: 503 error rate spiked to 4.7% across inference routes in us-west-2 (5m). SLA warning threshold exceeded.

eva (oncall): customer impact: a subset of customers on reserved capacity and hosted API experiencing increased latency and transient 503s. We'll need live mitigation — manual scale + fix metrics pipeline.

ben (sre): immediate plan: 1) Scale GPUs manually to relieve queue (temporary). 2) Restart prometheus-adapter & metrics-server to recover metrics feed. 3) If adapter doesn't recover, fallback routing to us-east-1 and enable degraded-mode (smaller models).

carla (ml-infra): executing step 1 -> `kubectl scale deployment inference-gpu -n inference --replicas=40`

carla (ml-infra): scale command accepted, cluster API shows new nodes provisioning. Expect pods ready in ~90s.

incident-bot: autoscaler blocked: HPA maxReplicas reached. Manual scale underway.

ben (sre): while we wait, throttling policy applied: token bucket reduced to preserve core traffic. Notifying support to throttle non-critical tenants.

eva (oncall): support notified, posted to #support for customer comms.

carla (ml-infra): prometheus-adapter restart attempt: `kubectl rollout restart deployment prometheus-adapter -n monitoring`

carla (ml-infra): adapter restarting, rolling pods. Checking prometheus scrape status.

carla (ml-infra): prometheus server shows increased scrape backlog; remote_write CPU spike. Looks like ingestion backlog caused adapter heartbeat misses.

ben (sre): if remote_write/backpressure is root cause, restarting adapter won't fix until Prometheus ingestion recovers. What's current scrape backlog?

carla (ml-infra): `prometheus_tsdb_wal_truncate_failures` trending, and `prometheus_target_scrape_pool: job=inference` shows last scrape 5m ago.

ben (sre): ok — escalate mitigation: divert some traffic to us-east-1 to buy time. Carla, can you flip routing policy for non-reserved customers?

carla (ml-infra): I'm gating by customer tier. Changing route weights: hosted-default -> us-east-1 at 30% for new requests. `kubectl apply -f route-shift.yaml`

carla (ml-infra): route change applied. New connections should land in us-east-1 within 10s.

incident-bot: queue length dropping slowly from 12k -> 6.5k after manual scale and routing shift. 503 rate down to 1.2%.

eva (oncall): good. Ben, I'm going to start a short on-call handoff in 10m. Please take lead if this persists.

ben (sre): acknowledged — I'll monitor. If prometheus ingestion doesn't recover in 15m, plan B: deploy a lightweight adapter proxy that serves cached metrics to HPA to allow upscaling. Preparing a config.

ben (sre): quick check: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep inference-gpu` -> `18/40 ready` — ramping.

carla (ml-infra): prometheus remote_write cluster is under load; restarting the heavy remote_write receiver helped previously. I'm going to throttle nonessential remote_write streams (metrics backfill jobs).

carla (ml-infra): paused backfill jobs; Prometheus ingestion backlog decreasing. Adapter heartbeats returning.

incident-bot: prometheus-adapter: heartbeat restored at 14:50:12. HPA custom metrics now available.

ben (sre): HPA now sees metrics, recomputing desiredReplicas -> desiredReplicas: 38 (below manual 40). We'll keep manual scaled until autoscaler stabilizes.

incident-bot: customer impact: 503s returning to baseline (<0.2%), queue latency median back to 1.8s. Incident moving to mitigated.

eva (oncall): handing off fully to Ben now — I'm on break. Key notes in thread: manual scale to 40, route shift to us-east-1 (30%), paused remote_write backfills, restart prometheus-adapter. Postmortem required: root cause likely Prometheus ingestion/backpressure causing adapter heartbeat miss -> HPA delay at critical autoscale window.

ben (sre): taking over. I'll open an incident in our tracker (INC-2026-0421) with timeline, actions, and customer impact. Next steps: - permanent alert to detect prometheus-adapter heartbeat gaps earlier - increase HPA maxReplicas or use emergency burst policy - add fallback cached metrics proxy for HPA - scale test Prometheus pipeline under similar load.

ops-bot: Reminder: schedule post-incident review in 48h and tag stakeholders: platform, ml-infra, sRE, product.

ben (sre): agreed. Closing live mitigation. Leaving thread open for follow-ups and postmortem notes.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED - INC-2026-0421 (status: mitigated).
